answer: Proof-of-distinct-work: every seat locks a slashable bond, and the verifier fingerprints each answer by shingle overlap. If two seats submit near-duplicate text, both bonds are burned and both payouts are voided. A Sybil operator running aliases named basalt, saffron, and ridge cannot recycle one answer; each fake seat needs its own bond and a genuinely different submission. The epoch purse is fixed, so N fake seats cost N bonds to chase the same pool, while any copy makes even honest-looking seats lose everything.
